notice.title: Windows 10/11 app launch issues fixed
notice.content: We've resolved the issues some users were having launching the windows app.
notice.full_content:
Users had reported issues launching the application around 7PM UTC on Windows systems, where neither new installs or existing would run on Windows 11/10 with Smart App Control enabled. This has now been resolved and apps should run as normal. False-positive reports were submitted to Microsoft and have now been actioned.
[see the installer.exe report to Microsoft](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/wdsi/submission/45d25b9c-0dd6-4d01-afd2-f0ea6b224dfd) [see the InnioasisUpdater.exe (main app) report to Microsoft](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/wdsi/submission/1aef842b-3fda-44e7-bcfb-1a64af3ea661)

notice.title: Rockbox Y1 Compatibility Warning
notice.content: This Rockbox-Y1 release predates 0.5 and is not compatible with Y1 units shipped with firmware 3.0.7 or later. Flashing will prevent booting.
notice.full_content: This Rockbox-Y1 release predates version 0.5. It is not compatible with Innioasis Y1 hardware shipped after March 2026 with Innioasis OS 3.0.7 pre-installed. Flashing this legacy build on those devices will prevent booting until restored via SP Flash Tool.

notice.title: Original Software Y1 Compatibility Warning
notice.content: This Original Software release predates 3.0.7 and will prevent booting on newer Y1 hardware until a compatible build is installed.
notice.full_content: This Original Software release predates 3.0.7. It is not compatible with Y1 units manufactured with Innioasis OS 3.0.7 or later. Flashing it will leave the device in a non-booting state until 3.0.7 or higher is installed using SP Flash Tool.
